subject: Post-incident review: Pinecrest throughput surge — RCA and ownership rollup
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-09-12T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: Pinecrest throughput surge — initial summary and ask

Team,

High-level incident summary (initial): Pinecrest observed a sustained throughput spike and elevated 5xx errors across their production inference routes between 2027-09-11 22:30 UTC and 2027-09-12 02:10 UTC. Customer impact: slow responses (p99 latency doubled) and ~4% error rate for ~3.5 hours.

What we did in first response:
- Throttled burst traffic to the dedicated pool for Pinecrest and enabled emergency fallback to smaller quantized model for a subset of routes.
- Increased autoscale headroom on their Dedicated pool and cleared a stale KV-cache shard on two nodes.
- Opened JIRA INF-4521 and started capturing perf traces (attached).

Immediate asks:
1) Monica — please produce a short RCA draft by EOD Monday (include KV cache traces, kernel selection notes, and autoscaler logs).
2) Laura — coordinate customer communications (I want a concise exec-level summary + mitigation timeline we can share).
3) Vivek — please prepare any credit/contract levers we may need to offer (cc: procurement/legal later).

Attachments: throughput-metrics-20270912.csv (perf), kv_cache_traces_20270912.zip (SRE traces).

I will prepare a one-page exec summary for Pinecrest leadership once we confirm root cause.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Reliability & Escalations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-09-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: Pinecrest throughput surge — initial summary and ask

Karthik / Laura / Vivek,

Root cause (summary):
- Primary driver: a mis-routed autoscale policy combined with an unusual tokenization workload pattern. During the spike, a small fraction of requests produced long sequences that prevented proper KV cache hits and forced full attention recomputation on a subset of GPU nodes.
- Secondary contribution: stale KV-cache shards on two Dedicated nodes caused cache misses that amplified CPU/GPU contention for KV warming.

Evidence:
- KV cache traces show repeated key eviction patterns on nodes gpod-12 & gpod-13 at 22:38 UTC. (See kv_cache_traces_20270912.zip)
- Kernel selection logs indicate fallback to a conservative attention kernel at ~22:42 UTC for sequences >2048 tokens which increased per-token latency by ~2.1x.

Mitigations we implemented: 
1) Cleared the stale shard and forced KV rehydration across the pool (complete 23:05 UTC).
2) Short-term routing: moved 20% of Pinecrest traffic to a quantized model variant that preserved semantics but reduced latency for long sequences.
3) Autoscale policy: rolled back a recent routing change that inadvertently pinned traffic to under-provisioned nodes.

Open action items for full close: 
- S1: Update autoscale routing rules to be sequence-length-aware (owner: infra-sre, ETA: 2027-09-18).
- S2: Add KV shard health checks and auto-rebalance (owner: monica.patel, ETA: 2027-09-16).
- S3: Run customer-facing load replay with Pinecrest test tokens to validate (owner: solutions-eng, ETA: 2027-09-17).

I am attaching a short technical appendix in the Drive link with relevant traces. Draft RCA attached as pinecrest_rca_v1.pdf.

- Monica
Monica Patel
SRE Lead, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@pinecrest.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, procurement@pinecrest.com
Date: 2027-09-15T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Pinecrest incident: RCA summary and corrective plan

Evan,

Thank you again for your patience while we completed the initial analysis. Please find the executive RCA attached (pinecrest_rca_v1.pdf) and a concise summary below.

Executive summary:
- What happened: A burst of long-sequence requests caused KV cache misses and triggered a kernel fallback on a subset of Dedicated nodes, which together increased p95/p99 latencies and produced transient 5xx errors.
- Impact window: 2027-09-11 22:30 UTC — 2027-09-12 02:10 UTC.
- Root causes: (1) sequence-length-unaware routing + changed autoscale rule that pinned traffic to under-provisioned nodes; (2) stale KV-cache shard on two nodes.

Our commitments to Pinecrest:
- Short-term: Completed KV shard rehydration and moved 20% of traffic to a quantized fallback variant during the event.
- Near-term fixes (by 2027-09-18): autoscaler rule update (sequence-aware routing), KV shard health checks, and load replay validation with your test tokens.
- Compensation: We will discuss a goodwill credit per contract terms; Laura will follow up with the concrete proposal.

Next steps: Laura will propose the credit amount and procurement steps. Monica and infra will share a final technical appendix with traces and a verification plan.

Please reply if you need any clarifications or want a 30-minute sync to walk through the RCA.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability & Escalations
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@pinecrest.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@pinecrest.com, Samuel Park <sam.park@pinecrest.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-09-16T10:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pinecrest incident: RCA summary and corrective plan

Thanks Karthik — the RCA looks clear and the near-term plan sounds reasonable. A few asks from our side:

1) We want a readout call this week with your infra leads where we can see the KV traces and ask questions.
2) Procurement: we need a formal credit proposal and a timeline for verification before we sign off on the SLA remediation acceptance.
3) Please run a replay of our production test-suite — we can provide sanitized tokens to validate the fixes.

Also: we had downstream impacts to the recommendation engine around 23:40 UTC that affected checkout conversion — this will be part of our internal postmortem and procurement will chase credits.

Appreciate the transparency.

Subject: Pinecrest credit proposal and approvals needed

Team / Pinecrest procurement,

Per the incident and the customer's loss estimate, I'm proposing the following goodwill credit structure:
- One-time platform credit equal to 10% of September estimated usage (applied to next invoice) + expedited verification window (complete replay & verification by 2027-09-18).

Vivek — can you approve an exception to the standard credit cap for this account? If you prefer, we can present two options (10% or 15%) and ask for executive signoff.

Procurement@pinecrest: if that structure is acceptable, Laura will prepare the DocuSign amendment and finance will queue the adjustment.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, East
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>

Date: 2027-09-20T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Closure: Pinecrest incident — final RCA & follow-through rollup

All,

Final status update and closure notes:

Summary of confirmed fixes (complete):
- KV shard rehydration and auto-heal enabled (owner: monica.patel) — Verified 2027-09-16.
- Sequence-aware autoscale routing rolled to production (owner: infra-sre) — Completed 2027-09-18.
- Replay validation with Pinecrest using sanitized tokens (owner: solutions-eng) — Completed 2027-09-18; metrics show p99 latency restored to SLA levels during the test.

Open items (tracked):
- INF-4521: Add automated KV shard health checks and rebalancer (owner: monica.patel) — in progress, ETA: 2027-10-05.
- INF-4522: Improve kernel-selection telemetry for long sequences (owner: infra-eng) — in backlog, ETA: 2027-10-12.

Customer commitments completed: replay verification & one-time 10% credit applied to Pinecrest account (HubSpot:HS-2027-8892). DocuSign amendment queued.

Attached: pinecrest_rca_v1.pdf (final), throughput-metrics-20270912.csv, kv_cache_traces_20270912.zip. Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPinecrestRCA, JIRA:INF-4521.

Thanks to everyone for the quick turnaround — Monica, clear technical work; Laura, smooth customer coordination; Vivek, prompt approval on exceptions. I'll mark this thread closed in the mailbox and update the executive tracker.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Reliability & Escalations
Redwood Inference
